name: Lupus Eclipse
source:
Lupus Eclipse is a visual novel set in Lua Nova, a city that has rapidly evolved thanks to the discovery of Lunar Energy. This powerful energy source is controlled by Lupus Corp, a company that, because of its monopoly, holds enormous influence over every decision made in the city.

Whoever controls Lupus Corp, controls Lua Nova…

[From [url=https://wolfo-bobo.itch.io/lupus-eclipse]Itch.io[/url]]
